title: Hosea 6:3 (Let Us Press On)
lyrics_original: So let us press on to know the Lord
So let us press on to know the Lord.
His going forth is as certain as the dawn
And He will come to us like the rain
Like the spring rain watering the earth
So let us press on to know the Lord.
So let us press on to know the Lord
So let us press on to know the Lord.
His going forth is as certain as the dawn
And He will come to us like the rain
Like the spring rain watering the earth
So let us press on to know the Lord.
author_english: Let Us Press On To Know The Lord

bible_verses.english: Let’s learn, and press on to know Yahweh. His going out is as certain as the dawn. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.
You will seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the wonderful promise that You will always answer when I draw near to You. Pour out Your Spirit upon my life like the gentle spring rain, renewing my heart and mind. Help me to press on daily to know You more deeply and walk in Your love. May my soul take comfort in Your unfailing faithfulness today. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for the wonderful promise that You will always answer when I draw near to You. Pour out Your Spirit upon my life like the gentle spring rain, renewing my heart and mind. Help me to press on daily to know You more deeply and walk in Your love. May my soul take comfort in Your unfailing faithfulness today. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Knowing God is not a passive waiting, but a joyful, daily journey of pressing closer to His heart. Just as surely as the sun rises every morning and the spring rains nourish the thirsty earth, the Lord promises to meet us whenever we seek Him. As you sing this song, open your heart to His faithful presence. Let His grace refresh your spirit today as you continually pursue a deeper relationship with Jesus.
